scientific_question: Which high-speed ventilation region is strongest in the office velocity field under a scientifically defensible analysis? Use velocity magnitude, treat face-connected retained locations as one region, and represent each region by the mean spatial location of those locations. Choose and state the high-speed criterion and the property measure used to compare region strength, then report the location and strength of the selected region.
